jobs.command: 0 18 * * MON-FRI sh -c '[ "$APP" = "espace-membre-cron" ] && npm run export-to-www || echo "skip export"'
0 3 * * * sh -c '[ "$APP" = "espace-membre-cron" ] && npm run job:sync-matrix-accounts || echo "skip sync-matrix-accounts"'

0 8 * * * sh -c 'if [ "$APP" = "espace-membre-cron" ]; then npm run job:api-keys-maintenance; npm run job:clean-teams-members; npm run job:remind-legacy-email-login; else echo "skip clean-teams-members"; fi'
0 8-18 * * * sh -c '[ "$APP" = "espace-membre-cron" ] && npm run job:sync-dinum-emails || echo "skip sync-dinum-emails"'
0 * * * * sh -c '[ "$APP" = "espace-membre-cron" ] && npm run job:recreate-email-if-user-active || echo "skip recreate-email-if-user-active"'
